title: Calliope Campus library
description: The curated library Calliope Campus shows in its import dialog: sections of tutorials, programs and materials.

version.description: Format version. Campus ignores a file whose version it does not know.

id.description: Stable id. Never reuse or rename one: Campus rooms will refer to sections and entries by id.

order.description: Sections are shown by ascending order. Leave gaps (10, 20, …) so later sections, also a room's own, fit in between.

external.description: Material by a third party, outside Calliope. Campus marks the section as external.

editor.description: The Campus editor the entry opens in. null (or missing) for material that needs no editor: videos, PDFs, boards.

urlNoHints.description: The same tutorial without hints. Campus offers a "with hints" switch for sections that have such entries.

imageUrl.description: Square-ish cover image. Without one Campus shows the label as the cover.

label.description: Short reference shown above the title, e.g. "S. 18 Aufg. 4" or "4.2".

grade.description: School years the entry is meant for.
